title: Vegetarian Garden Stir-Fry
description: This vegetarian stir-fry with lots of garden vegetables, chia seeds, and nuts is the perfect quick side dish for almost any meal, or it can be a vegetarian main.
ingredients: 0.5 cup dried fruit and nut mix, such as cranberries, almonds, and cashews
2 teaspoons cayenne pepper, or to taste
2 tablespoons shredded Cheddar cheese, or as desired

steps.text: Grease a large skillet with cooking spray and heat over medium-low heat. Add sugar snap peas, cherry tomatoes, fruit and nut mix, mushrooms, bell pepper, and chia seeds. Stir-fry about 2 minutes. Season with cayenne, garlic, and salt. Cook and stir about 2 minutes more.
Stir in egg whites slowly, mixing until they are cooked through, but not crusty, 3 to 5 minutes. Transfer stir-fry to a large bowl and sprinkle with Cheddar cheese. Let cheese melt and serve.
